title: Xyllow
tagline: Xyllowis a blockchain-based RealEstate Dapp where seller lists their properties and buyers can buy the property and get NFT of the property as a token of ownership. Here each property is represented by an individual NFT.
description:
It is a blockchain-based RealEstate Dapp where seller lists their properties and buyers can buy the property and get property NFT. Here each property is represented by an individual NFT.
Xyllow also includes Escrow properties such as Lenders, inspectors, appraisers, etc.
it is a real estate NFT marketplace where the person who wants to sell his property can list his property and a person who wants to buy a property can connect his wallet and search for the property and buy it and get NFT of the property as a token of ownership of the property. 
Dapps uses a basic frontend such as Home, Buy, and List pages; all the listed properties are shown at the bottom, and the user can search the property of a particular location.
It also includes features such as a Lender where the third person can lend money to the buyer to buy a property and the Appraiser can approve whether the purchase is correct.
how_its_made:
This uses the following tech:

Frontend:
ReactJs, HTML, CSS
Backend:
Solidity
Integration of Front and back:
Hardhat
Testing:
Mocha and Chai

Storage: IPFS

This project uses two smart contacts:
1: RealEstate contract for minting the NFT uses openzeppelin ERC721
2: Escrow contract handles buyer, seller, lender, inspector process.
